description: Get the transcribed text of a whole document in one call, with "--- page N ---" separators. Fetches at most 100 pages and 100000 characters per call; when more remain, the result carries nextStartPage.

endPage.description: Last page to include, inclusive (default: the document's last page)

maxChars.description: Character budget for the returned text, separators included (default 100000)

startPage.description: First page to include (default: the document's first page)

name: transkribus_doc_get_plaintext
title: Get Document Plaintext
